cases.proves_bugs: BUG-460 (PIT with the pit label layer locked is refused before the pit goes in: the New Pit window opens, Continue placement is pressed, CE says the pit was not inserted and names the layer, and the drawing object count does not move); BUG-672 (COPY of a pit with only the cover-text layer locked: the copy keeps its own pit number label, and CE reports the one thing skipped, the cover text, naming layer 25TEXT); BUG-262 (the wording half only: the schedule-cell lines name the pit, the column and the layer; the handle-only lines, the copied-cell line and the invert-text-layer line are not driven)
cases.title: With a pit text layer locked, PIT refuses before placing anything and COPY of a pit keeps its number label, names the cover-text layer it skipped, and one U takes the copy back
cases.plan_item: Native protection rule: locked pit text layers (triage group L1); BUG-460, BUG-672, BUG-262 (schedule-cell wording half)
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 25 Oct 2026 with BUG-460 (right result: refused before the pit goes in, like a locked pit layer), BUG-672 (expected: copy what sits on open layers and report the one skipped) and BUG-262 (expected: plain names of pit, layer and schedule column) as written in BUG_CARPARK.md. Not claimed: BUG-458 (REFEDIT), BUG-459 and BUG-565 (Edit Pit on locked text layers: the Edit Pit Save button is not on the driver's press list), BUG-312.
cases.expected: With the layer STORMWATER PIT LABEL locked, PIT at 150000,-80000 with cover level 19.000 and Continue placement prints "Pit not inserted - layer 'STORMWATER PIT LABEL' is locked" and the object count is unchanged. After unlocking it and locking 25TEXT, COPY of pit P3 prints "1 pit copied and numbered as new", then says the copied pit got its own number but no label or cover text because layer 25TEXT is locked, and names the schedule cells it could not update with the pit, the column and the layer. The copy is one new pit block on STORMWATER PIT and one new PIT LABEL block on STORMWATER PIT LABEL, no new "CL" text, and one U brings the object count back to what it was before the COPY. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: It needs AutoCAD's real layer lock, the real New Pit window and the real COPY clean-up.
not_automated: That the layers are STILL locked afterwards is shown only by the refusals; the layer lock flag itself is not read (the case unlocks them with AutoCAD's own -LAYER Unlock between parts).
PIT with the cover-text layer 25TEXT locked is typed once and RECORDED, not judged: BUG-460 says that layer is not checked either, and the right answer for it is not stated in the card.
The Pit Schedule drawn cells (BUG-246, BUG-312) and Edit Pit with a locked label layer (BUG-459, BUG-565) are not driven.
